<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Restock" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/restock">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Restock" name="Inventory Restock Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Restock">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Warehouse" name="Warehouse or Store Staff">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Restock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MonitorInventory</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AlertSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManualStockCheck</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AlertJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_StockReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InspectQuality</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordStock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceOnShelves</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Procurement" name="Procurement Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateSuppliers</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_InventorySystem" name="Inventory System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateAlert</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateDeliveryDates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateInventoryLevels</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_InventoryUpdated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Restock" name="Restock process started"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorInventory" name="Monitor inventory levels until threshold is reached"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AlertSplit" name="Alert or manual check?"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateAlert" name="Generate automated reorder alert"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_ManualStockCheck" name="Perform manual stock check"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AlertJoin"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateSuppliers" name="Evaluate suppliers on cost, delivery time and reliability"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order with supplier"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateDeliveryDates" name="Record expected delivery dates in inventory system"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_StockReceived" name="Stock received"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InspectQuality" name="Inspect stock quality"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RecordStock" name="Record received stock in system"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_PlaceOnShelves" name="Place stock on shelves or in storage"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" name="Update inventory levels"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_InventoryUpdated" name="Inventory levels updated after restock"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Restock" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_MonitorInventory" targetRef="Gateway_AlertSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Gateway_AlertSplit" targetRef="Task_GenerateAlert"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_AlertSplit" targetRef="Task_ManualStockCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_GenerateAlert" targetRef="Gateway_AlertJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_ManualStockCheck" targetRef="Gateway_AlertJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Gateway_AlertJoin" targetRef="Task_EvaluateSuppliers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateSuppliers" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_UpdateDeliveryDates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_UpdateDeliveryDates" targetRef="Event_StockReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Event_StockReceived" targetRef="Task_InspectQuality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_InspectQuality" targetRef="Task_RecordStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_RecordStock" targetRef="Task_PlaceOnShelves"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOnShelves" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" targetRef="EndEvent_InventoryUpdated"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
